name: Search API opensolr Security
description: Manages the IPs and HTTP Auth settings on opensolr cores.
project_description:
This module is directly supported by opensolr.com . It extends the main Search API Solr module and acts as a layer for connecting and managing solr services using opensolr services.

 Requirements and dependencies 
 The Search API Solr module is a required dependency, and starting version 2.2.0 , the previously required dependency Key module is now optional.

 Installation, documentation & configuration 
 
 Skip the boring stuff by using the  Get Started  feature launched in version 2.2.2 , that gets you up and running in minutes, without even having to have an opensolr account. This feature creates an account for you, automatically generates a core, updates your global configuration and generates a Search API Server with just a few clicks.

 
 🎬 Watch the Get Started video 

 Search API opensolr comes with a configuration page, and a submodule Search API opensolr security that is disabled by default.

 The configuration form can be found at: /admin/config/search/search-api/opensolr and it is mandatory to configure it before proceeding with anything else. This is the core of the module functioning well.

 
 Starting version 2.2.1 , a new feature called Autoconfigure facilitates the creation of: opnesolr core, drupal search api server and automatic upload of config.zip to opensolr with a click of a button.

 
 🎬 Watch Autoconfigure Demo 

 The optional sub-module helps site builders update the security of their cores without having to navigate to their opensolr account. One can update the core's basic authentication and can add/remove IP restrictions.
